notes.drops: Enemy carried item is guaranteed when that enemy actually dies; no independent drop flag. An empty-handed killer carries it, occupied killer chooses storage or replacement. Allied neutral/illusion killer sends it to convoy.
notes.player_death: Formal player unit carried item automatically goes to current-route convoy; neutral/illusion units are excluded.
notes.rare: Only enemy without a carried item; exact source character ID; two separate random[0,99] results must each be below threshold. Global cumulative count has source chapter($744C) caps and is not reset at chapter change. Disabled if source counter reaches5; native narrative chapter5 preserves source counter4 through scenario_source_chapter_counter.
notes.trade: Adjacent orthogonal living allied units only; target cannot have native flag4 (illusion/NPC). Swap item bytes and update usable equipped weapon; acting unit ends action via L069E1D.
notes.retreat: Player phase availability rolls once at phase initialization, not upon each menu opening. Return destination must not contain any world enemy. The source $7477 enemy-world-action branch uses the last matching route sequence in reverse lookup order and is disallowed in chapter2.
notes.forced_retreat: L06A50A checks the 40/60/255 turn table at enemy phase start. L06B7A6 then retreats the attacking world army: $7477=0 uses player route previous node; nonzero uses attacking enemy army previous node. Do not equate every timeout with player victory.
notes.storage_limit: Manual battle loot storage checks40; source automatic death/illusion storage has no capacity check. Native implementation preserves such automatic items even beyond40 instead of emulating SRAM overwrite.
notes.survivors: L08A3EE prunes defeated original enemy records from their army when retreating; it does not retain current HP. Next encounter restores remaining records with full HP.
